target: Anclaje geográfico del ramal B de la Ribera Sombría.
art_direction: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Ruta aparentemente natural que carece de las señales habituales de Velmora. Debe poder pasar desapercibida y no parecer un destino conocido.
prompt: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Create a wide forest-edge landscape of Sendero sin Marca. The recognized Velmora-oriented route remains subtly readable to one side through normal path wear and understated local orientation cues, while a second much less obvious line of compressed soil and displaced vegetation slips away between roots and trunks with no marker at all. The unmarked branch should only become apparent after careful viewing: plausible enough to follow, but not presented like a dramatic secret entrance. Low humid light, wet bark, deep greens, constrained visibility and natural forest clutter.
negative_constraints: No signpost, arrows, footprints highlighted for the viewer or readable marks
No glowing trail, secret-door effect, magical clue or cinematic spotlight
No visible boss, danger symbol, ruins or destination
Do not make the branch a wide maintained road
No characters or creatures as focal subject
CATEGORY LOCK: location/landscape only; geography is the primary subject.
canon_sources: vintage-telnet/REGIONAL_CONNECTIONS.md — Ribera Sombría / Ramal B: Sendero sin Marca
notes: Fiel al anclaje canónico. No definir interior, jefe, secreto, acceso mecánico ni historia adicional.
